scripts.worker: vite build && node worker/settings.mjs && wrangler dev --var MOCK:1 --port 8787
scripts.worker:todoist: vite build && node worker/settings.mjs && wrangler dev --var MOCK:calendar --port 8788
scripts.worker:live: vite build && node worker/settings.mjs && wrangler dev --var LOCAL:1 --port 8789 --persist-to .wrangler/state-live
scripts.deploy: vite build && node worker/settings.mjs && wrangler deploy
